slices.title: reconcile-project-memory
slices.summary: Reconciled the rejected ones checkpoint into one stable promotion ledger, accepted composition-environment decision, approved 20-slice proposal, active plan revision 18, and hygiene-complete successor contract v2. No product code changed, later-column generalization remains gated, and unrelated user-owned files remain untouched.

slices.title: freeze-full-timeline-laws
slices.summary: Froze the complete documentary workspace lifetime, same-node and monotone-dimming policies, measured evaluated-total destinations, measured curved carry transit, exclusive opaque endpoint handoff, direct-seek, rewind, responsive measurement, and native settlement in the canonical visual reference. The reference owns explicit cells rather than borrowing a preservation summary.

slices.title: type-lifetimes-and-regions
slices.summary: Added one geometry-free persistent-workspace contract with nominal sealed semantic regions and discriminated full-timeline documentary versus native-endpoint lifetimes. Documentary sources can only remain opaque or dim monotonically; endpoints remain mounted and can reveal only by exclusive handoff. Static and runtime cases reject copied authority and wrong region roles.

slices.title: type-destination-route-transit-handoff
slices.summary: Separated semantic destinations, geometry-free measured route intents, continuous opaque transit ownership, and exclusive native endpoint handoff into nominal sealed contracts. Handoff can only compile when route target, endpoint destination, and full-timeline native endpoint lifetime are the exact same certified objects and semantic entity.

slices.title: compile-persistent-workspace-plan
slices.summary: Compiled one nominal geometry-free place-value persistent-workspace plan from the sealed foundation and matching written projection. It closes all 13 native entities and seven trace beats, declares full-timeline lifetimes, and exposes only ones contribution convergence, result settlement, and carry-arch handoff behind the human generalization gate. Removed an over-broad negative type fixture rather than accepting compiler-cost growth.

slices.title: add-adversarial-conformance
slices.summary: Added renderer-facing nominal conformance authority and closed the remaining duplicate-paint hole by treating each transit as a single-use handoff capability. Adversarial cases for scene replacement, disappearing documentary history, wrong or copied routes, authored teleport geometry, copied plans, and duplicate endpoint claims fail before runtime.

slices.title: mount-one-persistent-scaffold
slices.summary: Mounted one connected written scaffold through every beat, made its conformance certificate part of the sealed runtime-session-to-renderer path, and retained each local native-scene overlay as an absolutely positioned prepared layer. Wide and phone browser checks prove stable native root identity without remounting.

slices.title: anchor-ones-convergence-to-target
slices.summary: Added one generic typed target-destination convergence anchor. The ones written-workspace compiler selects it, the native compositor measures the 14 destination, and dense wide/phone browser evidence proves opaque contributors converge there below the rule with documentary clearance and deterministic direct seek/rewind. Default separate-band callers retain source-band behavior.

slices.title: complete-visible-carry-transit-and-handoff
slices.summary: Separated semantic fission transfer from native endpoint ownership in the typed frame and removed the ambiguous transfer boolean. Remainder and carry material now remain opaque through measured routes; the persistent scaffold reveals endpoints only at absolute route completion. Dense wide/phone paint—not wrapper-box—checks prove curvature, opacity, font/baseline settlement, seek, rewind, and atomic handoff.

slices.title: human-ones-checkpoint
slices.summary: HUMAN_CHECKPOINT. Committed exemplar scope now proves the ones operation only: persistent documentary scaffold, exact measured 14 convergence, opaque full-size remainder and carry, cross-browser collision-free measured perimeter arch, and exclusive native endpoint handoff. The focused wide/phone Chromium Firefox WebKit matrix passes 12 of 12, unit/type/architecture/inference/build gates pass, and the canonical Animation Library host mounts in all three browsers. The broad visual suite remains intentionally red at progress 0.4 where the unported legacy tens overlay duplicates persistent paint, plus three stale DPR grid queries. No s11 later-column work began; explicit human visual approval is required.

slices.title: generalize-approved-plan-to-later-columns
slices.summary: Generalized the approved exemplar to every current ordered radix position through one required ownership and compositor path. Reusable APIs contain no ones/tens/hundreds branches; fixture labels live only in the 278 plus 156 adapter. Global interval clearance prevents three-contributor documentary collisions, results and carries persist in the one scaffold, terminal output hands off to that same native scaffold, and focused wide/phone Chromium Firefox WebKit evidence passes. Actual unequal-width and decimal fixtures remain later certification work.

slices.title: handle-terminal-overflow
slices.summary: Defined exhaustive terminal fit versus adjacent result-extension semantics over generic radix positions. Static input modes prevent carry-shaped terminal data, runtime validation enforces exact radix adjacency and one-position growth, and persistent-workspace output roles route overflow into a durable result endpoint rather than transient carry ownership. Current 278 plus 156 behavior is unchanged; the second visual overflow fixture remains s16 evidence.

slices.title: certify-full-documentary-lifetime
slices.summary: Certified the complete canonical documentary lifetime at wide and phone widths in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit. Dense 0 to 100 percent sampling proves all six addend glyphs, the addition operator, and underline remain the exact same connected stationary nodes; addends dim monotonically to the approved documentary value without hiding; stationary marks remain opaque; and reverse traversal plus scrambled direct seeking reproduce the exact forward states.

slices.title: remove-ones-specific-branches
slices.summary: Removed the final named-position authority branches from the reusable presentation compiler. Evaluations now resolve through ordered position specs; exchange and carry programs resolve through nominal lineage proof identity; terminal versus nonterminal output topology determines result ownership; and native settlement validates the complete compiled settled-output set. The compiler moved from 23 named-position terms and eight beat-ID branches to zero, with a source-level regression gate and 12-case cross-browser motion proof.
